summary: Osisko Gold Group filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing the closing of a US$30 million strategic equity investment by Urion Investments Holdings, a Trafigura affiliate. Osisko issued 9,554,141 common shares at US$3.14 each, a 10% premium to the five-day VWAP prior to signing, leaving Urion with roughly 3.0% of the 315,809,214 shares outstanding. Urion signed a voting support agreement with standstill and lock-up provisions; shares carry a four-month-plus-one-day Canadian hold period. Proceeds fund the Cariboo Gold Project; TSXV final acceptance pending. Watch for a potential US$120 million prepayment facility.
